title: Fathom
description: A GPU deep-zoom explorer for a family of escape-time fractals — Mandelbrot, cubic & quartic Multibrots, the Burning Ship, Tricorn, Celtic and Perpendicular sets — each in its parameter plane or any point's Julia set. Emulated double precision reaches ~1e13; a perturbation engine (BigInt reference orbit + float32 deltas with rebasing, now generalized to z^p+c) dives past 1e28. Stripe-average & orbit-trap colouring, normal-map relief, interior shading, progressive rendering, an auto-dive, distance-estimation outlines, and shareable deep links.
